new_today_news.headline: Septic Truck DOT Inspection Requirements Explained
new_today_news.summary: Article covers DOT inspection requirements for septic trucks, including annual inspections and daily pre-trip/post-trip compliance requirements under FMCSA regulations for commercial motor vehicles.

recent_news.headline: Vecino Expands Second Location to Cleveland
recent_news.summary: Award-winning Mexico City-inspired upscale eatery Vecino expands from Detroit to Cleveland with opening planned for November 2026.

backfill_news.headline: Carl's Jr. Franchisee Struggles Drive Strategy Shift
backfill_news.summary: Carl's Jr. franchised store count declined from 1,020 in 2024 to 942 by end of fiscal 2026 as franchisees struggle with profitability.

backfill_news.headline: Detroit Announced as Host City for First Michelin Guide American Great Lakes Ceremony
backfill_news.summary: Detroit selected to host inaugural Michelin Guide American Great Lakes Ceremony, positioning the city as culinary destination.
